discription: A short, percussive sound using a sawtooth wave with a quick decay envelope and a resonant low-pass filter for a plucky timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=5000, rq=0.5;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.15, 0.0, 0.3, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Saw.ar(freq);sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
